purpose: Obtain early results on four GPUs, then continue the same experiment on eight GPUs without restarting training.
access: Existing member, verified with my_slurm_accounts and sacctmgr; no new group membership required.
routing: Automatic partition selection with generic GPU GRES, RTX6000 constraint, preemption=yes;requeue=true

outputs: validation one-step skill and shortwave error power
depth-resolved imprinting metrics and summary figure
interim.interpretation: Early diagnostic checkpoint, not the final 70-epoch result.

stage8.resume: stage4 raw ckpt.pt, restoring optimizer, scheduler, EMA, and fixed residual output scales
stage8.dependency: stage4 succeeds and interim GPU eval finishes; interim eval failure does not discard a valid training checkpoint

scientific_limit: Changing rank count and accumulation can change local BatchNorm statistics and sample grouping. This is a staged experiment, not a GPU-count ablation or an exact reproduction of an uninterrupted eight-GPU trajectory.
validation: Stage CLI configs validate, effective batch is 32 in both, and resumed Adam/cosine state follows the same 70-epoch learning-rate trajectory.
